task.title: Require explicit Emacs authentication opt-in
task.objective: Prevent ambient auth-source credential discovery or transmission unless the user explicitly configures a token provider
acceptance_criteria: The default token provider is nil
Default requests neither query auth-source nor include an Authorization header
Explicit token providers and auth-source opt-in continue to work

attempts.summary: Added regressions asserting unauthenticated default lookup and header behavior
attempts.diagnostic: Two tests failed because the default provider performed ambient auth-source lookup

attempts.summary: Defaulted the provider to nil while retaining explicit provider and auth-source paths

outcome.summary: Emacs gateway requests are unauthenticated by default and access credentials only through explicit configuration

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1100

lessons: Credential discovery is a permission boundary and should require affirmative configuration
Preserve one runtime token path while changing only the authority that enables it
